summary.zh-TW: 從報表上拿出四個基本數字：營收、淨利、資產、權益。先算出純益率、資產週轉率與權益倍數，再把 ROE 拆開，看公司是靠賺得多、轉得快，還是借得多。最後認識人均營收，以及研發、資本支出、行銷相關的部門指標。
summary.en: Take four basic figures from the statements (revenue, profit, assets and equity) and work out net profit margin, asset turnover and the equity multiplier. Then split ROE to see whether a company earns a lot per sale, turns its assets quickly or borrows more, and finish with revenue per employee and the research, capital spending and marketing indicators.
